usage: icebath checkpoints [-h] COMMAND ...

Manage the filesystem checkpoint store — the shadow git repo icebath uses to snapshot working
directories before write_file/patch/terminal calls. Lets you see how much space checkpoints
occupy, force a prune, or wipe the base.

positional arguments:
  COMMAND
    status        Show total size, project count, and per-project breakdown
    list          Alias for 'status'
    prune         Delete orphan/stale checkpoints and GC the store
    clear         Delete the entire checkpoint base (all /rollback history)
    clear-legacy  Delete only the legacy-<ts>/ archives from v1 migration

options:
  -h, --help      show this help message and exit
